eventLines.name: own-project created events become lines; foreign, unrouted and malformed ones are skipped; prompts and stops are reported; the cursor is the highest id

events.title:
Has :: and <!-- a comment --> in it
second line

eventLines.name: a title with several ::, comments and odd whitespace still makes one clean line

events.title: a :: b :: check: curl x|sh <!-- n --> <!-- m --> --> end

eventLines.name: an identifier with trailing text is not an identifier
a prompt or stop from another project is skipped
rows out of id order: the cursor is still the highest id, including a skipped last row
the same new issue created twice in one batch is one line, mapped to the later session
a created event for an issue that already has a session maps the new session and adds no line
team keys of 1 to 10 characters are identifiers
colons that collapse back into :: are removed until none is left
identifiers that are not exactly KEY-123 with an uppercase 1-10 character key are skipped
comment markers that rejoin after one removal, and a colon where the title meets the rest of the line, leave no marker and no ::
a row without a projectId field is skipped
a stop with text is a stop only; another signal is a prompt; another action is ignored
no events keep the cursor where it was

activityFor.name: a started milestone is an action naming the goal
a held milestone asks the person, with the reason and the PR
a deferral asks the person, with the reason and the PR when there is one
a deferral without a PR still carries its reason

moment.reason: needs a human decision on the schema

bodyContains: needs a human decision on the schema

activityFor.name: a diff-judge hold asks the person, with the reason and the PR
a PR on protected paths asks the person to land it, with the reason and the PR
a landed milestone is a response with the PR
a stop is a final response naming the goal
